Sandbox_DelHeat_PlayersBuild_tooltip: With the crafted parts and a pipe wrench; the parts come back when a thing is taken apart. Radiators: any player. Everything else: the head and staff of an organization with the Heat supply activity (Delirium Economy, ticked by an admin). Off: only admins build.
Sandbox_DelHeat_FuelCapacity_tooltip: How much fuel a boiler house holds. One unit is one game hour of an idle boiler.
Sandbox_DelHeat_BurnPerHour_tooltip: Units a lit boiler burns every game hour whatever it feeds.
Sandbox_DelHeat_BurnPerRadiator: Extra fuel per radiator per hour
Sandbox_DelHeat_BurnPerRadiator_tooltip: Added to the hourly burn for every radiator the boiler feeds.
Sandbox_DelHeat_HeatUpPerMinute: Water heats up, degrees per game minute
Sandbox_DelHeat_HeatUpPerMinute_tooltip: Radiators start to warm at 30 degrees of water and give full heat at 80.
Sandbox_DelHeat_CoolDownPerMinute: Water cools down, degrees per game minute
Sandbox_DelHeat_CoolDownPerMinute_toolti: While the furnace is out or has no fuel or water.
Sandbox_DelHeat_WaterCapacity_tooltip: A boiler house without water does not burn. The tank is filled by water intakes through the pipes.
Sandbox_DelHeat_WaterPerHour: Water lost per game hour, litres
Sandbox_DelHeat_WaterPerHour_tooltip: What a burning boiler loses every game hour whatever it feeds.
Sandbox_DelHeat_WaterPerRadiator: Extra water per radiator per hour, litres
Sandbox_DelHeat_WaterPerRadiator_tooltip: Added to the hourly loss for every radiator the boiler feeds.
Sandbox_DelHeat_IntakeRate: Water intake output, litres per game hour
Sandbox_DelHeat_IntakeRate_tooltip: What every working intake adds to each boiler house its water reaches.
Sandbox_DelHeat_IntakeReach: Reach of a water intake, cells
Sandbox_DelHeat_IntakeReach_tooltip: How many cells of pipe the water travels from an intake without a pump.
Sandbox_DelHeat_BoilerReach: Reach of a boiler house, cells
Sandbox_DelHeat_BoilerReach_tooltip: How many cells of pipe the hot water travels from a boiler house without a pump.
Sandbox_DelHeat_PumpReach: Reach of a pump station, cells
Sandbox_DelHeat_PumpReach_tooltip: A working pump sends the water that reached it this many cells further.
Sandbox_DelHeat_PumpNeedsPower_tooltip: They work only on a powered square (a generator nearby). Without power a pump passes the water like a plain pipe and an intake gives none.
Sandbox_DelHeat_InletRadius_tooltip: Radiators this close to a heat unit with hot water work, three floors up and down.
Sandbox_DelHeat_RadiatorTemp_tooltip: Air temperature right at the radiator. A vanilla fireplace is 35.
Sandbox_DelHeat_RadiatorRadius_tooltip: The heat fades to nothing at this distance. Walls and closed doors stop it.
Sandbox_DelHeat_PetrolPerLitre: Fuel units per litre of petrol
Sandbox_DelHeat_FuelTable_tooltip: item:units pairs separated by semicolons. A drainable item (a propane tank) gives its units when full. An unreadable table is replaced with the default one.
